title: Waymo starts offering rides at the Las Vegas airport | TechCrunch
summary: The company already offers rides at Phoenix Sky Harbor, Nashville International, San Antonio International, San Francisco International, and San José International airports. Amazon-owned Zoox already offers rides at the Vegas airport, and more robotaxis are coming to Sin City.
